name: Natac Natural Ingredients, S.A.
summary: Natac Natural Ingredients, S.A. engages in producing sustainable natural ingredients from botanicals and fish in Europe, Asia, Latam, North America, and internationally. It offers its products to nutraceutical, animal feed, pet nutrition, pharmaceutical, food, and cosmetics industries. The company was formerly known as IFFE Futura, S.A. Natac Natural Ingredients, S.A. was incorporated in 2011 and is headquartered in Getafe, Spain.
